learning_outcomes.text: Students can apply engineering knowledge and methods for biomechanical analysis of human movements.
They have basic knowledge of bicycle spiroergometry.
They have basic knowledge of the metrological acquisition of mechanical forces.
They are able to realize metrological investigations considering basic biomechanical and ergonomic aspects and to carry out a corresponding performance diagnostic.
They are able to work on an interdisciplinary task in teamwork and to prepare understanding-oriented protocols and test reports.

syllabus_topics: Movement analyses on a bicycle ergometer built by the Institute of Mechanical Engineering of TU Clausthal in cooperation with the Institute of Sports.

Movement analyses with variation of selected parameters, different sitting or standing positions, without and with clipless pedals etc. in connection with spiroergometric examinations and assessment of subjective perceived exertion.
assessment_rules: The course grade for the Practical Course Biomechanics accounts for 100% of the module grade.
